comments.text: Hi Ruchell, I also suggested before for you to review banks with free insurance (Security Bank AllAccess and BPI-Pamana). And I'm glad you did. :) Actually, I think you're the first on Youtube to make a review of the All Access account with Free Insurance. I actually asked FWD to provide me a copy of my Statement of Benefits, and they did (it was given on a monthly basis). Unfortunately, they stopped providing me with it, because they said: " With regards to your Statement of Benefit for the months of January and February, we were advised by SBC last Thursday, 03/11/2021, that there are still some major data issues in the data extract and they need to do validation to ensure correctness of data." But I'll try to request again. But as I looked at the provided SOB, the benefits are really good. LIfe and Critical Illness are both 3x your ADB for the past 3 months. Plus the accidental death benefit (1x only). What I would like to ask them is if for example I have 100k in my account, and I made a claim (hopefully not), will it be 300k for the benefit, excluding my existing balance? or is it just the 300k and no more existing balance? Anyway, thank you so much for this video. :)
